nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
- <Subject 1>: The adult woman from <Picture 1>, preserving her exact facial identity, fair complexion, slim athletic proportions, long pale-blonde hair, vivid rainbow-colored strands, and distinctive braided details. Her original black outfit is adapted into a fitted black sleeveless combat dress with black ankle-support martial-arts shoes; no handbag, jewelry, or high heels.
- <Subject 2>: The adult woman from <Picture 2>, preserving her exact facial identity, fair complexion, slim athletic proportions, and long dark-brown hair. Her ivory outfit is adapted into a fitted ivory sleeveless combat top, flexible ivory trousers, and white ankle-support martial-arts shoes; no high heels.
- The women must remain visually distinct and consistent throughout the video. Do not merge their faces, hairstyles, hair colors, limbs, or costumes.
summary:
reference generation. Create a 10-second cinematic close-quarters martial-arts fight between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> inside a professional elevated fighting ring. The choreography is extremely fast, sharp, controlled, graceful, and clearly readable. Every movement plays at real-time speed with no slow motion, speed ramping, pauses, or frozen hero poses.
retention_analysis:
- <Picture 1> → <Subject 1>: fully_preserved for facial identity, rainbow-streaked pale-blonde hair, braid details, complexion, and body proportions; attribute_transfer for transforming the black fashion outfit into a combat-safe black costume.
- <Picture 2> → <Subject 2>: fully_preserved for facial identity, long dark-brown hair, complexion, and body proportions; attribute_transfer for transforming the ivory fashion outfit into a combat-safe ivory costume.
- The white character-sheet backgrounds, duplicate turnaround views, handbags, jewelry, and high heels are excluded from the generated scene.
detailed_description:
High-end cinematic martial-arts photography with elegant East Asian action choreography, powerful silhouettes, precise body mechanics, crisp contact timing, cool overhead arena lights, warm rim lighting, subtle atmospheric haze, and restrained sweat highlights. The women fight as highly trained professionals: rapid but controlled, graceful but forceful, without supernatural effects.
[Shot 1] <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> are already locked in a tight standing clinch at the center of a raised square fighting ring, surrounded by dark ropes and a dim, out-of-focus audience. <Subject 1> sharply breaks the grip, fires a compact right elbow toward the shoulder, then immediately follows with a fast left palm strike. <Subject 2> slips outside the elbow, deflects the palm with her forearm, catches the attacking wrist, and pivots into a short shoulder throw attempt. <Subject 1> lowers her center of gravity, blocks the throw with a wide step, twists free, and answers with two rapid body hooks. <Subject 2> absorbs them on tight forearm guards. Their hair and fitted costumes react naturally to each abrupt acceleration. The camera performs a fast, controlled medium-distance clockwise orbit, keeping both faces, hands, and footwork visible.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a low three-quarter tracking angle. <Subject 2> drives forward with a short knee feint, a straight palm strike, and a tight spinning elbow. <Subject 1> checks the knee, redirects the palm past her cheek, ducks cleanly beneath the elbow, and slides behind her opponent. Without pausing, <Subject 1> hooks an arm around the waist for a takedown. <Subject 2> plants one foot, rotates her hips, escapes the grip, and counters with a swift outside leg sweep. <Subject 1> hops over the sweep and lands in balance. The camera executes a rapid lateral dolly with a brief, precise whip-pan following the reversal; no shaky camera and no motion that hides the choreography.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a slightly wider frontal view. Both fighters explode into a final synchronized exchange: <Subject 1> throws a fast jab-cross combination while <Subject 2> parries both, counters with a spinning backfist, and transitions into a controlled hip throw. <Subject 1> redirects the throw’s momentum into a fluid aerial roll, lands on one knee, and instantly rises as <Subject 2> turns into guard. They stop face-to-face in balanced fighting stances, breathing hard, eyes locked, ready to continue. The camera makes a quick push-in and locks on their intense expressions. Full-speed real-time action only—no slow motion, no speed ramps, no freeze frames, no duplicated limbs, no broken anatomy, no blood, no visible injuries, no dialogue, no subtitles, no logos, and no readable text.
overall_soundscape:
A subdued indoor arena crowd surrounds the ring with short reactions to each reversal. Include rapid footwork on the canvas, cloth snaps, sharp hand-to-forearm impacts, controlled body-contact thuds, ring-rope vibration, brief breaths, and a final synchronized foot plant. All impacts are crisp and precisely synchronized, without exaggerated bone-breaking sounds.
non_diegetic_music:
A fast, elegant action score at approximately 155 BPM, combining taiko-style drums, tight electronic percussion, low strings, and brief plucked-string accents. The rhythm intensifies through each exchange and stops on a sharp final beat as the fighters enter their closing stances.
